units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Setting the language of a single note

units.source: To set the language of the content of a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note, there is a language selector in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Status bar__TRILIUM_PH_3__ indicated by a __TRILIUM_PH_4__ icon.
units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Setting the language of a single note
Content language & Right-to-left support > Adjusting the list of languages

units.source: By default, no language is configured. To configure them, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Language & Region__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Content languages__TRILIUM_PH_5__, or select the __TRILIUM_PH_6__Configure languages...__TRILIUM_PH_7__ item when setting the language. The enabled languages are listed by their native names, sorted alphabetically, which is also the order the language selector shows them in. Here you can:
units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Adjusting the list of languages

units.source: Add a language by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Add a language__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button (__TRILIUM_PH_3__Add another language__TRILIUM_PH_4__ once one is enabled), which also shows how many languages are left, and then selecting it.
units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Adjusting the list of languages

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button beside a language to remove it from the list.
units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Adjusting the list of languages
Content language & Right-to-left support > Default content language

units.source: Notes that do not have a language of their own follow __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Language & Region__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Default content language__TRILIUM_PH_5__. It is set to English initially, and can be set to any content language, or to __TRILIUM_PH_6__Based on the application's language__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
units.context: Content language & Right-to-left support > Default content language

units.source: If a note has a language set, it always takes precedence over the default.
